change_summary: Changed grid from static tuple `(triton.cdiv(xnumel, 128),)` to lambda `lambda meta: (triton.cdiv(xnumel, meta['XBLOCK']),)` so the autotuner dynamically computes the correct grid size for each XBLOCK config instead of always launching 16 blocks.
